tools/checks/tests/test_branch_page_note.why: Pins the wording of the per-turn branch-cleanup note (stale-branch-cleanup's reply gate) and that it exits 0 with no engine; wording plus a never-fail guarantee, near free.

tools/checks/tests/test_branch_rules_opt.why: tools/precedent_branch_rules.py (shipped by act) writes GitHub branch rules; this proves it changes nothing without the person's opt-in and never touches a repository they do not own.

tools/checks/tests/test_file_header.sh.why: The live file-header check, including --fix-staged, which the person's commit-time fixer runs on every commit (and, since 2026-10-31, the only copy that fixer runs). Cheapened 2026-10-31: fixture git runs with the global commit hooks off (core.hooksPath=/dev/null), keeping PRECEDENT_SKIP_COMMIT_FIX=1; same cases and failure words, and it still fails against a check that never fires. 25.8 s -> 11.3 s in the review's measurement; 29.6 s -> 11.9 s in this pass's.

tools/checks/tests/test_ladder_branches..why: Promote, Produce, --land, --run-tests and the main-test wait end to end (24 checks, hundreds of stated cases); a miss lands work on the wrong branch or drops main's commits. 24 s is one case (46 stated cases, about 20 real CLI runs at ~1 s each); global hooks are not the cost (39.5 s with them off).

tools/checks/tests/test_landing_authorit.why: A Prompt Please block that orders a landing must carry the person's quoted Booked; a miss hands another session a landing nobody authorized.

tools/checks/tests/test_landing_takes_a_.why: go-update's check that a workflow or gating-file change reaches the landing branch only through a PR; a miss lands an unreviewed gate change.

tools/checks/tests/test_others_did.sh.why: others_did.py runs at every SessionStart and prompt (others-did hooks); tests it counts from the person's last commit, writes nothing to origin and stays silent off the ladder.

tools/checks/tests/test_session_branch_n.why: act's branch-name check and its pre-push guard: flags harness-named and hand-made branches, passes tool-made ones; a false fire would refuse a push.

tools/checks/tests/test_upstream_review..why: upstream_review.py is the step_review the engine calls at Booked, Debut and Produce; tests it is shown only to a code owner on the ladder and skips what commits already record.
